subject.title: fix(agents): tighten grepSchema context/limit from Type.Number to Type.Integer

question: Should the grep tool reject fractional `context` and `limit` arguments at the schema boundary, rather than continuing to accept and normalize them downstream?
rationale: The patch is technically sound, but it intentionally narrows a model-facing input contract that current releases accept, so maintainers should explicitly own that compatibility choice.

options.title: Accept integer-only arguments
options.body: Merge the schema tightening because line context and match counts have no meaningful fractional representation.

options.title: Preserve permissive number input
options.body: Keep the current schema if downstream normalization of fractional model output is considered an intentional compatibility behavior.

recommendation.title: Accept integer-only arguments
recommendation.body: Merge the schema tightening because line context and match counts have no meaningful fractional representation.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository explicitly assigns this person to agents/subagents, making them the best available owner for the tool-contract decision.
